description: UCI row 6 (age 53, LOW vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 6) — structured note: hard fails ['R7'] -> UNSUITABLE
client_narrative: Przemysław Witek is 53 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 65,500 euros (around 5,458 euros per month). They hold 43,300 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 3,600 euros with a 3-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 6 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 3,600 euros if the investment performs poorly.
product_narrative: The product is a euro-denominated capital-protected structured note issued by an investment-grade European bank, providing 80% participation in Euro Stoxx 50 appreciation at maturity with full capital protection if held to maturity. It is classified COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(b) due to its conditional payout formula and issuer credit dependency; moderate financial knowledge is required to evaluate the risk properly. The recommended minimum holding period is five years.
